nonBlockingIssues.description: Models are trained eagerly in __init__ with only 6 hardcoded benign samples each. Each instantiation triggers IsolationForest.fit(). Consider lazy initialization or a module-level singleton for production workloads.
stop_monitoring() return type changed from BehavioralProfile to Optional[BehavioralProfile]. Callers outside this file should be checked for None-handling.
_identify_suspicious_processes() now relies solely on the ML process anomaly model, removing the old name-matching heuristic. No static fallback if the model drifts.
_build_reasons uses a hardcoded z_score > 1.5 threshold for significant features. Consider exposing this as a configurable parameter.
Path validation helpers only check existence, not directory confinement. A client could reference any file on the system. Pre-existing architectural pattern, not a regression.
analyze_memory_dump passes memory_scan_batch_size and memory_scan_max_wait_seconds from args.get() which may return None. Low risk since MCP clients typically validate against the schema.

asyncio.run() is called inside a function dispatched via asyncio.to_thread(), creating a nested event loop pattern. This works correctly but is non-obvious and could break if someone later calls _dispatch_stage_execution from an async context directly. An inline comment would help.
Only 2 test cases for a 925-line change. Missing edge-case coverage: all stages failing, forensics disabled, recompilation disabled, invalid binary path.
Behavioral forensics mode has a minimum 1.1-second wall-clock wait per pipeline execution via time.sleep(). Will slow down future integration tests exercising the real path.
_candidate_ghidra_urls hardcodes fallback port 13370 which is not documented in services.yaml or AGENTS.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add coding convention: 'When using asyncio in the pipeline engine, note that stage handlers run inside asyncio.to_thread() (a threadpool thread with no running event loop). It is safe to call asyncio.run() within these handlers. Do NOT call stage handlers directly from an async context.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: e2e-pipeline-integration introduced asyncio.run() inside asyncio.to_thread()-dispatched handlers in pipeline_engine.py:680. This pattern is non-obvious and was flagged by the reviewer as easy to break if someone changes the dispatch model.
